description: Knowledge-update scenarios: a fact about a subject changes over time. Records carry explicit ages in days; the harness stamps created_at accordingly. Kinds: update (newer value wins), negation (newer record only retracts the old value), past_trap (the newer record describes the past, the older one stays current), other_subject (the newer record is about someone else).
